notes:
Five cascaded inverting op-amp stages, each with its + input grounded and a reactive feedback element from output back to the - input. Net map: 0 = ground, shared by GND 16 (under I-DC 10), GND 18 (under V-DC 4), GND 19 (op-amp 1 +), GND 20 (op-amp 7 +), GND 21 (op-amp 2 +), GND 22 (op-amp 6 +); n1 = V-DC 4 top lead -> horizontal at y~106 -> op-amp 2 in-, with the riser at x~110 T-ing up to the left plate of cap 14; n2 = op-amp 2 out -> right to the junction at (219,117) where cap 14's right plate comes down at x~213, continuing into the left end of R13; n3 = R13 right -> op-amp 11 in-, with the riser at x~301 T-ing up to inductor 9's left end; n4 = op-amp 11 out -> junction at (409,104) where inductor 9's right end comes down at x~409 -> left end of R5; n5 = right rail: R5 right -> down the vertical at x~508 from y~100 to y~394, T-joined by R3's right end at (503,264) and terminated by R0's right end at (508,394); n6 = middle rail: op-amp 6 out -> up at x~144 to y~273 -> right through the junction dot at (186,272) -> left end of R12; the same rail carries inductor 8's right end and, via the long slanted line, op-amp 11 in+ (up from (186,272) to (177,187), then right/up at y~180 to x~317, then up to op-amp 11's + pin) and cap 23's left plate (down from (186,272) to (200,411), then right); n7 = I-DC 10 top lead -> right at y~327 to op-amp 6 in-, with the riser at x~61 T-ing up to inductor 8's left end; n8 = R12 right -> op-amp 1 in-, with the riser at x~273 T-ing up to cap 17's left plate; n9 = op-amp 1 out -> right to (361,271) where cap 17's right plate comes down at x~361 -> left end of R3; n10 = cap 23 right plate -> right at y~407 to op-amp 7 in-, with the riser at x~274 T-ing up to inductor 15's left end; n11 = op-amp 7 out -> right to (375,408) where inductor 15's right end comes down at x~374 -> left end of R0.
Judgment calls: (a) the only true wire crossing in the drawing is at (186,272), where the long slanted line from op-amp 11's + input to cap 23 crosses the middle rail; at 16x it carries an unmistakable filled junction dot, so it is ONE net (n6) - op-amp 6's output therefore drives R12, cap 23 and op-amp 11's + input. (b) Every other apparent meeting is a T (a lead terminating on a through-wire), not a crossing: the feedback risers at x~110 (cap 14), x~301 (inductor 9), x~273 (cap 17), x~274 (inductor 15), x~61 (inductor 8), and R3's right end landing on the right rail at (503,264). (c) Op-amp polarity read at 12-14x on all five: op-amps 1, 2, 6, 7 and 11 all have "-" on the upper input and "+" on the lower input; terminals are stored (in+, in-, out). Four of the five + inputs go straight to their own GND symbol; op-amp 11 is the exception - its + input is the long slanted wire down to the n6 rail, which is why the drawing has 6 GND symbols for 5 op-amps plus 2 sources (GND 16 and 18 belong to I-DC 10 and V-DC 4). (d) The bootstrap had inductor 8 as ['0','0'] and inductor 15 as ['n9','n9'] (shorted); both are actually feedback elements spanning op-amp in- to op-amp out, so those were re-traced from the ink. (e) Cap 14, 17 and 23 and I-DC 10 give nets whose only DC-blocking members are in parallel with a resistor or an op-amp path, so every node still has a DC path to the reference; no Tier 2 findings expected. (f) All 2-terminal parts are stored left-then-right (top-then-bottom for V-DC 4 and I-DC 10), which does not affect any metric.
